description: A narrow white paper strip lies on the wooden tabletop in front of the person’s hands. The left hand steadies the strip near its middle while the right hand folds the upper section across to form a T-shape, then rotates and refolds the long end down and back out, creasing and adjusting so the paper alternates between a T and an L shape as it’s unfolded and repositioned; the paper is a two-hand object throughout.
